codes.message: The workflow run could not be cancelled.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: The workflow run could not be loaded.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: Workflow runs could not be listed.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: Logs for the workflow run could not be loaded.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: Workflow run {runId} was not found.
codes.hint: Run "kb workflow runs list" to inspect available runs.

codes.message: The workflow run could not be rerun.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: The active workflow run cannot be restarted.
codes.hint: Wait for the workflow run to finish, then retry the restart.

codes.message: The workflow run could not be restarted.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: The workflow run could not be started.
codes.hint: Run "kb logs query" to inspect the workflow service, correct the reported cause, then retry.

codes.message: The workflow run snapshot was not found.
codes.hint: Run "kb workflow runs list" to select a run with an available snapshot.

codes.message: Workflow step {stepId} was not found.
codes.hint: Run "kb workflow runs view <run-id>" to inspect the workflow steps.

codes.message: Services did not become healthy before the readiness timeout.
codes.hint: Run `kb-env status` and inspect service logs, then retry after correcting the failure.

codes.message: A monitored service reported a failure.
codes.hint: Run `kb-dev status` to inspect the service and its health checks.

codes.message: The update could not be applied; the previous version {version} was restored.
codes.hint: Inspect the local log and the diagnostic dossier, fix the reported cause and run "kb-create update" again.

codes.message: The requested platform version {target} is older than the installed version {installed}.
codes.hint: use `kb-create rollback`

codes.message: Downloading the update failed.
codes.hint: Check the network and run the update again.

codes.message: The host did not become healthy after the update; recovery restored the last healthy version {version} or needs attention.
codes.hint: Run `kb-create doctor --platform-root ROOT` using the platform root from the failed command. Read the host log and report the correlationId.

codes.message: The update is incompatible with installed {kind} {component} at {version}; its declared compatibility range is {range}.
codes.hint: Update or remove {kind} {component} first, then rerun `kb-create update`.

codes.message: There is no snapshot to roll back to.
codes.hint: Reinstall the previous version with "kb-create apply".

codes.message: Update cannot change or create installation secret {secret}.
codes.hint: Stop the host and run `kb-create apply` with the required `--secret-env` mapping.

codes.message: Verification after the update failed; rolled back to {version}.
codes.hint: Inspect the diagnostic dossier and report the correlationId.
